title: Redis cluster split-brain caused by AZ network partition — order-svc 100% error rate for 5 min
description: Transit gateway route table update at 10:57Z withdrew route for subnet 10.1.2.0/24, isolating Redis nodes in us-east-1a from us-east-1b. Both AZ halves elected a Redis primary causing split-brain. order-svc cart writes failed 100% for 5m. Reverted by commit b7c8d9e0. Service restored at 11:05Z.

title: Add AZ connectivity validation to infrastructure change pipeline
description: Add pre-apply Terraform validation that checks cross-AZ connectivity for critical subnets (Redis, DB, Kafka). Gate network changes on health check passing. Add runbook for Redis split-brain recovery.
